description.value:
Frequency once per day

Range 30 feet

Targets 1 creature

Attempt to Recall Knowledge about the target as part of this action, even if you don't meet the normal requirements to try. On a success, you also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your next check or saving throw against it this encounter. The Ledger keeps better books than you do.
